sections.Profile:
"Vegas" is a solid-state cocktail-style pinball machine released by Game Plan Inc. in August 1979. Designed by Ed Cebula with artwork by Dick White, it accommodates up to four players.

- Manufacturer: Game Plan Inc.
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Cocktail, Gambling, Cities, Original Theme, 1970s, Solid State
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Cebula
- Art: Dick White
